info.description:
Welcome to Public API reference of Kolay!

This documentation is here to help you easily integrate your existing apps to Kolay. In order to use this API you need to have an API Token ready. If you don't have an existing API Token you can visit the following link and create one for your needs https://app.kolayik.com/settings/developer-settings If you have any technical questions you can contact us via apisupport@kolay.io

item.name: Person

request.description:
You can create a single person with all the basic information populated. Only the firstName and the lastName fields are mandatory, others are optional. All skipped fields default to null unless otherwise stated.

person

Person Object Model

person.dataList

This is a list of additional person data fields. This object attribute only accepts an array of objects. Objects can only have two properties named fieldToken and value.

[
    {
        "fieldToken": "adres",
        "value": "Selam Sok. 33/4"
    },
    {
        "fieldToken": "evTelefonu",
        "value": "02123456666"
    }
]

person.unitList

This field is the unit list of a person and accepts an array of unit objects, so you can choose to add historical data or only the active unit. If the field default is true that means it will be the default unit throughout the system.

  • employmentType fulltime parttime intern freelance daily contracted mobile
[
    {
        "startDate": "2020-08-13",
        "endDate": "2020-08-14",
        "employmentType": "fulltime",
        "managerId": null,
        "default": true,
        "active": true,
        "items": [
            {
                "unitName": "Şirket",
                "unitItemName": "Smith Group"
            },
            {
                "unitName": "Şube",
                "unitItemName": "Amsterdam"
            },
            {
                "unitName": "Departman",
                "unitItemName": "Sales"
            },
            {
                "unitName": "Unvan",
                "unitItemName": "Enterprise Sales Asisstant"
            }
        ]
    }
]

person.compensationList

You can use this field to provide compensation and salary information for the person. It only accepts an array of objects. So you can use this field to add all historical compensation data, it this case only the 'active: true' one will be the current.

  • payPeriod monthly daily yearly weekly hourly
  • type bonus food transportation healthInsurance personalRetirement

item.description:
The person object model

The Person API is a central place to get all information and do actions about persons including create, update, delete and etc.

Throughout the API all person-related fields will have the following properties. Do not forget that all employees including the admins and the non-login employees are a person object.

  • firstName and lastName can only contain letters.
  • email and workEmail must be a valid e-mail address. They can not be the same.
  • mobilePhone and mobilePhoneCountryCode both should be given. Phone number format would be validated with the country code.
  • workPhone and workPhoneCountryCode both should be given. Phone number format would be validated with the country code.
  • employmentStartDate must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
  • contractType definite or indefinite
  • contractEndDate must be in YYYY-MM-DD format and mandatory if contractType is definite.
  • workingDayId is the 32-char ID of the person's working day calendar. (automatically set to system default)
  • accessType: employee manager owner details
  • birthday: YYYY-MM-DD
  • bloodType: A- A+ 0+ 0- AB- AB+ B- B+
  • educationLevel: primary secondary high_school associate bachelor master doctorate none
  • educationStatus: graduate or student
  • educationalInstitution: free text field (max 150 character)
  • gender: female male unspecified
  • idNumber: TCKN if the nationality = TR or free text field
  • levelOfDisability: notDisabled thirdLevel secondLevel firstLevel
  • maritalStatus: married single divorced unspecified
  • partnerWorkStatus: working notWorking
  • militaryService: completed uncompleted exempt delayed deserter draftEvader
  • militaryServiceDelayDate: YYYY-MM-DD
  • nationality: Alpha-2 country code such as TR GR ES
  • numberOfChildren: 1 .. 10
  • tourStatus: completed canceled active passive If you want your users not to see an onboarding flow about how to use the product, you can use passive. (default: active)

request.description:
View Payroll Sheet

Returns the complete payroll sheet data (Çarşaf Bordro) for a given payroll run as JSON. This is the API equivalent of the Excel export.

Scope: payroll-sheet:view

Request

POST /v2/payroll-sheet/view/{id}
Parameter Type Required Description
id string Yes 32-char payroll ID

Body

{
  "filter": {
    "search": "Ahmet",
    "status": ["ended"],
    "salaryPeriod": ["monthly"],
    "insuranceId": ["setting_id"],
    "taxId": ["setting_id"],
    "expenseCenterId": ["setting_id"],
    "units": [["unit_item_id"]]
  }
}

All filter fields are optional. Send {} to get all employees.

Filters

filter.search

string — Free text search by employee full name. Supports Turkish characters.

filter.status

array — Filter by one or more statuses (OR logic).

Value Description
ended Calculation completed, payslip not created
started Calculation in progress
failed Calculation failed
hasPayslip Payslip created
isPayslipPublic Payslip published to employee
changedColumns Employee data changed since last calculation
activeEmployee No termination date
terminatedEmployee Has termination date

filter.salaryPeriod

array — Filter by salary period type.

Value Description
monthly Aylık
hourly Saatlik
attendance_fee Huzur Hakkı

filter.insuranceId

array — Company setting IDs for SGK workplaces.

filter.taxId

array — Company setting IDs for tax departments.

filter.expenseCenterId

array — Company setting IDs for expense centers.

filter.units

array of arrays — Organizational unit item IDs. Each inner array is AND-ed.

"units": [["branch_item_id"], ["department_item_id"]]

Response

{
  "error": false,
  "data": {
    "columns": { "firstName": "Ad", "lastName": "Soyad", "..." : "..." },
    "dynamicColumns": {
      "benefits": { "<type>": { "label": "Yemek Yardımı", "grossLabel": "Brüt", "netLabel": "Net" } },
      "deductions": { "<type>": { "label": "İcra", "netLabel": "Net", "turnoverLabel": "Devir" } },
      "promotions": { "<code class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml'>": { "label": "05510" } },
      "units": { "<unit_id>": { "label": "Departman" } }
    },
    "rows": [ { "..." : "..." } ],
    "meta": { "total": 150, "payrollId": "uuid", "year": 2026, "month": 1 }
  }
}

columns

Static key→label map for all fixed fields. Use as table headers.

dynamicColumns

Column definitions that vary per company/payroll:

  • benefits — Each has gross and net values in row data

  • deductions — Each has net; allowance and enforcement also have turnover

  • promotions — SGK incentive codes; row data has the amount per code

  • units — Organizational units; row data has unit item name or null

rows

Array of employee objects. Key fields per row:

Group Fields
Personal personId, registrationNumber, firstName, lastName
Payroll payrollYear, payrollMonth, hasPayslip, payrollStatus, errorMessage
Employee idNumber, gender, disabilityLevel, isRetired, governingLaw, specialityCode, employmentStartDate, employmentTerminationDate, terminationReason, employmentType, sgkWorkplace, sgkWorkplaceNumber, taxDepartment, taxNumber, expenseCenter, expenseCenterNumber, iban
Units units — object keyed by unit ID → item name
Income wageType, salaryPeriod, baseWage, dailyWage, payableDay, wageGross, wageNet, overtimeGrossTotal, overtimeNetTotal, benefitsGrossTotal, benefitsNetTotal, allIncomesGrossTotal
SGK workDay, restDay, publicHoliday, paidLeaveDay, unpaidLeaveDay, sickDay, otherMissingDays, workHours, sgkDay, baseSgkWage, sgkExemptionTotal, sgkMonthlyTopWage, carryoverFromLastMonth, usedFromCarryover, carryoverToNextMonth, sgkMonthlyBase, employeeSgkPay, employeeUnemploymentPay, employeeSgkTotal, employerSgkPay, employerUnemploymentPay, employerSgkTotal, employerSgkTotalWithoutPromotions
Income Tax incomeTaxBase, disabilityExemption, incomeTaxExemptionTotal, previousMonthCumulativeTaxBase, cumulativeIncomeTaxBase, incomeTaxRatios, incomeTaxMonthlyBase, incomeTaxAmountBeforeMinimumWageExemption, minimumWageIncomeTaxExemption, incomeTaxAmount, incomeTaxExemptionByPromotions, incomeTaxPayment
Stamp Tax stampTaxBase, stampTaxExemption, stampTaxMonthlyWage, stampTaxAmountBeforeMinimumWageExemption, minimumWageStampTaxExemption, stampTaxAmount, stampTaxExemptionByPromotions, stampTaxPayment
Deductions taxCutTotal, privateDeductionsTotal, inKindTotal, allDeductionsTotal
Promotions promotions (object keyed by code → amount), promotionsTotal
Wage monthlyWageGross, monthlyWageNet
Employer Cost paidAmount, employeeCostTotal, totalIncentives, employeeCostTotalWithPromotions
Overtime restDayHour, restDayGross, restDayNet, publicHolidayOvertimeHour, publicHolidayOvertimeGross, publicHolidayOvertimeNet, workDayOvertimeHour, workDayOvertimeGross, workDayOvertimeNet
Severance severanceGross, severanceNet, noticeGross, noticeNet, remainingLeaveDaysGross, remainingLeaveDaysNet
Benefits benefits — object keyed by type → { gross, net }
Deductions deductions — object keyed by type → { net } or { net, turnover }
Calculation calculationDate (ISO 8601), calculationId

meta

Field Type Description
total integer Number of employees returned
payrollId string Payroll run ID
year integer Payroll year
month integer Payroll month (1-12)

Examples

All employees, no filter:

{}

Completed monthly employees:

{ "filter": { "status": ["ended"], "salaryPeriod": ["monthly"] } }

Search + specific SGK workplace:

{ "filter": { "search": "Melih", "insuranceId": ["setting_id_here"] } }

Employees needing recalculation:

{ "filter": { "status": ["changedColumns"] } }

Errors

Code Description
401 Invalid or missing API token
422 Validation error (invalid payroll ID, invalid filter values)

List Payroll Periods

Returns the list of payroll runs (bordro dönemleri) for a given year. Use this to get payroll IDs before calling the View Payroll Sheet endpoint.

Scope: payroll:list

Request

GET /v2/payroll/list?year=2026

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
year integer No Filter by year. Max value: current year + 1. Defaults to current year if omitted.

Response

{
  "error": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "abc123def456ghi789jkl012mno345pq",
      "period": "2026-01-01 00:00:00",
      "year": 2026,
      "month": 1,
      "total": 150,
      "payslips": 120,
      "errors": 2,
      "employerCost": 1250000.50,
      "updatedAt": "2026-01-15"
    },
    {
      "id": "rst678uvw901xyz234abc567def890ghi",
      "period": "2026-02-01 00:00:00",
      "year": 2026,
      "month": 2,
      "total": 152,
      "payslips": 0,
      "errors": 5,
      "employerCost": 1280000.75,
      "updatedAt": "2026-02-14"
    }
  ]
}

Response Fields

Field Type Description
id string Payroll run ID. Use this as {id} in /v2/payroll-sheet/view/{id}.
period string Period start date as datetime string (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss)
year integer Payroll year
month integer Payroll month (1-12)
total integer Total number of included employees
payslips integer Number of generated payslips
errors integer Number of failed calculations
employerCost number Total employer cost (sum of all included employees)
updatedAt string Last update date (YYYY-MM-DD)

Examples

All payroll for current year (default):

GET /v2/payroll/list

Filter by year:

GET /v2/payroll/list?year=2026

Errors

Code Description
401 Invalid or missing API token
422 Validation error (e.g. year is not an integer or exceeds max value)
